Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
Sl. or proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  08.10.2024 C482 No. 1120 of 2024  With  C482 No. 1121 of 2024  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.

1. Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Amit Bhatt, learned Government Advocate for the State and Mr. Sanjeev Aggarwal through V.C. with Mr. H.M. Bhatia, learned counsel for the complainant.

1. These two matters were heard at length on several occasions and the judgment was reserved on 09.09.2024 and the counsels for the parties were directed to file their synopsis with the compilation and in compliance thereof, all the parties submitted their synopsis with the compilation of the judgment.

2. While dictating the judgment, it appears that the entire issue, as involved in both the applications are arising out of the First Information Report lodged on 24.05.2024, bearing FIR No. 119 of 2024,
P.S. Rajpur, District Dehradun, wherein both the applicants have been implicated for the offence punishable under Section 306 of IPC which is also evident from the remand order dated 01.06.2024 which is under challenge in both the present C482 Applications.
3. Further, as it appears from the remand order dated 01.06.2024 both the applicants were sent on remand by adding penal provisions i.e. Sections 385, 420, 120B IPC in Case Crime No. 119 of 2024.

4. It is also informed to this Court that the First Information Report dated 24.05.2024 bearing Case Crime No. 119 of 2024 has been challenged by both the applicants by two separate writ petitions i.e.
WPCRL No. 562 of 2024 and WPCRL No. 570 of 2024 which are still pending, therefore, both these matters are directed to be listed along with WPCRL No. 562 of 2024 and WPCRL No. 570 of 2024 before the appropriate Bench.

(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 08.10.2024 Mahinder/
C482/1120/2024 on 8 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183848975/
